snip.t: Hemorrhage into adrenal glands can occur in the neonatal period as a consequence of a difficult labor (especially breech presentation), or its etiology might not be apparent.

○ Prenatal risk factors include parental age, consanguinity, a history of drug or teratogen\nexposure, maternal diseases (diabetes/epilepsy), reduced fetal movements, polyhydramnios,\nand breech presentation.
